title: DevExtreme jQuery Page Spec
description: Authoritative input contract for scripts/generate-dx-page.js. Every field declared here is consumed by the generator; the generator reads nothing that is not declared here. Breaking changes mint a new $id path segment and a new schemaVersion major.

schemaVersion.description: Spec contract version. Producers stamp this; the generator refuses versions it does not implement.
schemaVersion.errorMessage: schemaVersion must be "1.0.0". This generator implements exactly one spec contract version.

title.description: Page title. Emitted into <title> and the <h1 data-page-title> heading, HTML-escaped.

template.description: Template directory under templates/ that supplies index.html and styles.css.

devextremeVersion.description: DevExtreme version used to build the default CDN URLs. Default: 25.2.3.
devextremeVersion.errorMessage: devextremeVersion must be a three-part version such as "25.2.3".

themeCss.description: Override for the DevExtreme theme stylesheet URL. Default: https://cdn3.devexpress.com/jslib/<devextremeVersion>/css/dx.light.css

devextremeJs.description: Override for the DevExtreme script URL. Default: https://cdn3.devexpress.com/jslib/<devextremeVersion>/js/dx.all.js

jqueryJs.description: Override for the jQuery script URL. Default: https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.1.min.js

containers.description: Optional markup grouping. Each container becomes one <section> in the generated body, in declaration order, holding every widget whose containerId points at it. Omit this key to get one section per widget.

id.description: Container identity. Referenced by widget.containerId. Not emitted as an element id; the section carries it as data-container.

className.description: Extra CSS classes appended to the section's class attribute.

label.description: Optional heading rendered as <h2> at the top of the section, HTML-escaped.

widgets.description: Component initializers. Each entry becomes exactly one $('#id').<type>(options) call. Callable APIs such as DevExpress.ui.notify are NOT widgets - express them as handler actions (see $defs.handler).

sampleData.description: Named data sets emitted as a const in app.js. Array values feed dataSource; object values feed formData.

additionalProperties.errorMessage: sampleData entries must be an array of record objects (for dataSource) or a single object (for formData).

tokens.description: Design tokens flattened into CSS custom properties on :root as --<group>-<name>. Values may be scalars or DTCG-style { "value": ... } wrappers.

outputFiles.description: Output file names. The generated HTML links whatever names are declared here. Defaults: index.html, styles.css, app.js.

domId.errorMessage: must be a DOM id starting with a letter and containing only letters, digits, underscores, or dashes.

cssClassList.errorMessage: must be a space-separated list of CSS class names.

outputFileName.errorMessage: must be a plain file name with no path separators (e.g. "index.html"). Output paths are resolved against --out.

safeString.errorMessage: must not contain JavaScript source. Function bodies are prohibited in specs; use a handler object such as { "kind": "named-reference", "name": "handleSubmit" } instead.

handler.description: A typed action. Handlers replace raw JavaScript strings: the generator emits the call site itself, so no spec value is ever interpolated as executable code.

name.description: Key looked up on window.dxPageHandlers at call time. The generated page degrades gracefully when the handler is not registered.
name.errorMessage: must be a plain JavaScript identifier naming a handler registered on window.dxPageHandlers.

oneOf.title: notify
oneOf.description: Calls DevExpress.ui.notify(message, type, displayTime). This is a callable API on the DevExpress.ui namespace, not a component - it can only be reached through a handler, never declared as a widget.

displayTime.description: Milliseconds the toast stays visible. Default: 2000.

validationRule.description: DevExtreme declarative validation rule. Only the callback-free rule types are expressible: 'custom', 'compare', and 'async' require JavaScript functions and are therefore outside this contract.

optionValue.description: Any JSON value permitted inside a widget options tree. Strings are checked against safeString so JavaScript source cannot be smuggled through.

optionsObject.description: DevExtreme option bag. Keys matching ^on[A-Z] are DevExtreme event handlers and must be handler objects; validationRules must be declarative rules; everything else is plain JSON.

id.description: Id of the mount element the generator emits and initializes. Must be unique across widgets.

containerId.description: Container this widget is rendered into. Required to reference a declared container when containers are present.

label.description: Used as the default toolbar title / button caption for those widget types. Not emitted as markup.

className.description: Extra CSS classes on the widget's mount element.

dataKey.description: Key into sampleData supplying dataSource (array) or formData (object). Must exist in sampleData.

columns.description: Column definitions merged into options.columns. Declared here so column config is a first-class, validated part of the contract.

items.description: Form items merged into options.items. When any item carries validationRules or isRequired, the generator wires a validation group and a validated submit helper.

displayFields.description: Record fields joined into each list item's text. The generator emits its own displayExpr function; specs never supply one.

submitsValidationGroup.description: Names a dxForm validation group. The generator emits a click handler that runs DevExpress.validationEngine.validateGroup before the button's own onClick handler.

oneOf.title: other supported DevExtreme components
oneOf.description: Components the generator initializes verbatim: it emits the mount element, merges elementAttr, applies dataKey, and passes options straight through. No type-specific defaults are supplied.
